file_name: Shepparton Automotive Group – Darryl Twitt Motors dealerships in Shepparton East, Victoria - Phase 1 consultation.pdf

questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships you have with SAG and/or DTM.
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if SAG and DTM are close competitors, or if there is only a small number of competing dealerships in the area.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Identify the dealerships you most closely compete with and specify the automotive brand (for example, Toyota or Mazda) that each represents. In your response, explain what makes them a strong competitor (e.g. price, range, proximity, or service level).

For any new car dealerships you operate in the Greater Shepparton region, specify the distances or areas your customers travel to purchase a new car. If known, please provide the percentage of customers who travel 0-10km, 10- 20km, 20-30km, and 30-40km to purchase a new car from the dealership. If you do not operate any new car dealerships in the Greater Shepparton region, please respond to the above based on other dealerships you operate in the surrounding areas, such as Echuca, Cobram, Kyabram, Wangaratta, or Bendigo.
Which automotive brands most closely compete with each of the brands sold by SAG and DTM (Hyundai, Misubishi, Suzuki, Ford, Honda, Volkswagen, Audi, BYD, and Geely)?
